name: iter_vary_sigma_schedule
description: The kernel-width half of the relax-the-focus extension. Sweeps the per-iteration SIGMA schedule (constant / widen / narrow / adaptive-to-severity) against the starting kernel width, with the rehearsal mix pinned at the operating point so sigma is the only coverage control moving. The paper showed mix and sigma to be substitutable routes to coverage in a single round; this asks whether they stay substitutable when scheduled over a loop. Accumulative regime, 8 iterations, one detector, 10 seeds.
